constraints: All input components use forms supported by the token-counting endpoint; no MCP connector, unsupported server tool, or URL/file image source is included.

details.boundaryOrTradeoff: Token estimates can guide admission but do not replace handling an API rejection explicitly; a different model or request shape requires its own preflight.
details.errorCorrection: Latest-message counting omits input, billing is not capacity, and a text character ratio is not a reliable estimate for multimodal request components.
details.mechanismOrProperty: The token-counting endpoint estimates input tokens for supported structured components, including system text, client tools, and base64 images. Supported forms and thinking accounting depend on the target model and request; output capacity needs separate budgeting.
details.scenarioApplication: Count the complete supported input for this target model, apply its documented thinking/output accounting, and compare with the application capacity budget. Handle estimate differences or an API rejection explicitly.

feedback.reason: Admission must account for the actual input shape and the generation capacity the application needs. Billing estimates and text-only approximations do not establish context fit.

options.text: Count the latest user message, then use a fixed percentage multiplier for tools, images, and the rest of the conversation.
Estimate cost from cached versus uncached tokens and admit the request when the expected bill is within its per-request budget.

prompt: A gateway checks capacity before sending a target-model request containing system text, conversation messages, client-defined tool schemas, and base64 images. The chosen model supports the configured thinking mode. Which admission check is appropriate?

options.text: Increase the requested context capacity and retain the transcript layout so every prior observation remains equally available.
